title: Spec: addition of relative paths to v4
summary: This bundle holds only replies to the vote on adding relative paths to the V4 spec; the message that opened the vote, and any result message, are not included. All eight replies are +1. Fokko thanked Dan and Talat for working on the change. zhjwpku voted +1 (non-binding) and said he had left a few minor comments that would be good to address. kevinjqliu and Steve remarked that it was good to see the work come together and V4 progressing; Steve credited Dan with the spec change. RussellSpitzer, stevenzwu and kevinjqliu marked their votes binding, while laskoviymishka, zhjwpku, huaxingao and Steve marked theirs non-binding, and Fokko did not mark his. No concerns or objections were raised in these replies.

positions.stance: Votes +1 (non-binding) and left a few minor comments that should be addressed.

outcome.note: No result message is in the thread. The replies show eight +1 votes: three marked binding, four marked non-binding and one unmarked; no -1 votes.
